## Predictions, registered before anything is measured

THE GRID, and the residency it computes to on the attached card:
    sm_90  228 KiB smem/SM  2048 threads/SM  32 blocks/SM  132 SMs  63 MB L2   [read off NVIDIA H200]
    L2 provenance: read off NVIDIA H200 (L2_cache_size)
    one CTA streams 1.31 MiB over its K loop, weighted over both GEMMs

    s2w4g1       warp                        32 KiB/CTA   6 blk/SM (smem   )      1040 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.942
    s2w8g1       occ/warp                    32 KiB/CTA   6 blk/SM (smem   )      1040 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.942
    s3w4g1       warp                        48 KiB/CTA   4 blk/SM (smem   )       693 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.913
    s3w8g1       occ/swz/warp                48 KiB/CTA   4 blk/SM (smem   )       693 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.913
    s3w8g8       swz                         48 KiB/CTA   4 blk/SM (smem   )       693 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.913
    s3w8g16      swz                         48 KiB/CTA   4 blk/SM (smem   )       693 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.913
    s3w8g64      swz                         48 KiB/CTA   4 blk/SM (smem   )       693 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.913
    s4w8g1       occ                         64 KiB/CTA   3 blk/SM (smem   )       520 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.885
    s5w8g1       occ                         80 KiB/CTA   2 blk/SM (smem   )       346 MiB in flight  alpha_conc 0.827

P1  CONCURRENCY. alpha rises with resident blocks per SM. The LRU
    caricature predicts a swing of +0.115 in alpha between the top and
    bottom rungs of the residency ladder above. The gate takes half of
    that, 0.058, floored at 3 sigma of the fitted alpha's own
    replicate spread, which is measured and not assumed. A FAIL means
    concurrency does not set alpha and the cross-card null was not
    saturation.
P2  PROGRAM ORDER. Reuse distance predicts alpha(G=64) / alpha(G=1) = 1/min(G, 8.5 tiles
    per expert) = 0.118; uncapped it would be 0.0156. The gate gives the
    predictor a factor of 2 and passes at 0.235. The published corpus
    sits at 0.69-0.78, so this is expected to FAIL, and a FAIL here is
    the interesting outcome: it says the standard predictor does not
    transfer to this regime.
P3  THE CONTROL. num_warps changes resident WARPS at fixed resident
    BLOCKS, so the concurrent data footprint is unchanged and P1's
    mechanism predicts NO movement. The gate is that the warp contrast
    is smaller than the occupancy contrast. A FAIL says the residency
    reading is confounded by something num_warps changes -- latency
    hiding, register pressure, scheduling -- and P1 cannot be read as
    a footprint effect.
P6  THE OTHER CONTROL, and the one this design usually cannot run.
    num_stages sets residency AND software-pipeline prefetch depth, so
    P1's axis carries two mechanisms. They come apart ONLY where two
    num_stages compute the SAME resident-block count, and after the
    BLOCK_M=256 reference prunes the ladder neither real card has such
    a pair: the H200 runs 2/3/4/5 stages at 6/4/3/2 blocks and the A100
    runs 2/3/4 at 4/3/2. So P6 is expected to report UNKNOWN on a pod,
    which counts AGAINST the run and is the honest accounting: the
    concurrency reading is not established, and CONCURRENCY may not be
    quoted without that clause. The self-test plants P6's PASS and FAIL
    branches on a card that does not exist and says so.
P4  THE NULL IS A RESULT. If P1 and P2 both FAIL the verdict is
    NEITHER (null), printed as such and not forced into a branch.
    It would retire both models at once and point at DRAM scheduling,
    the replacement policy or sector granularity instead.
P2b WHAT THIS DESIGN CAN READ AT ALL, checked against P2 before the run.
    The memory prefix runs n* = k(1-alpha)/(1-k alpha) treads with k = b ridge / 2BM = 2.389, so:
      floor      alpha < 0.140 leaves fewer than 3 treads above the compute branch
                 and the setting reports nothing;
      dead band  alpha in [0.356, 0.481] is DISCARDED by the fit, because the two
                 branches are then within 15% of each other and are one line.
    Taking a published alpha(1) near 0.93, P2's own prediction lands at 0.109,
    which is UNDER the floor, so a reuse-distance world shows up here as a collapse and not as a ratio.
    ROUTE TWO covers the case where a setting does fall in the dead band or under the
    floor: wide-G settings losing their memory branch while G=1 keeps its is scored as
    a PASS for P2, and the report says which route it took.
P5  THE LEVEL IS NOT PREDICTED, only the differences, and the differences are ATTENUATED.
    A B/(A+B) ladder fit returns alpha_fitted = (alpha_b + phi) / (1 + phi + delta) (EXA), and
    this grid pins BM, BN and K, so phi is common to every setting and a contrast reads
    (alpha_b(1) - alpha_b(2)) / (1 + phi + delta): the cache term's difference scaled, not the
    difference itself. The scaling is a BRACKET, 0.50 to 0.98 here at alpha_a = 1 to 0
    (alpha_a is unmeasured; delta only lowers it), and delta is per-setting, so a level
    difference alone can move a fitted alpha. The geometric terms do NOT cancel exactly; the
    sign and order of every contrast above survive the scaling and their magnitude is a lower
    bound on the alpha_b difference. No gate here is scored on an absolute alpha.

timing.clock_rule: DRIFT excludes; BOTH LEVEL sides are kept with the side recorded, because the under-load clock is set per tile by the kernel's own power draw under the cap; the fixed roof is what the compute-bound gates score against; the four LEVEL counts are over the STEADY rows only and with the drift count they partition the timed rows; this file drops no row for its clock

run.compiled_smem_note: vLLM exposes no fused_moe_kernel with a Triton cache under either known path, so the compiled shared memory could not be read

gates.name: V1 card provenance
gates.prediction: the residency ladder and the L2 come from the ATTACHED card
gates.rule: no HYPOTHESIS value reaches a measured run
gates.observed: limits: read off NVIDIA H200; L2: read off NVIDIA H200 (L2_cache_size)
gates.invalidates: every rung of the residency ladder and the whole of P1's predicted swing: a per-SM shared memory or an L2 borrowed from another part puts the x axis and the threshold on a machine that was not measured

gates.name: V2 residency swept
gates.prediction: the occupancy arm actually moved resident blocks per SM
gates.invalidates: P1 entirely, and P3 with it: a grid that computes one residency at every setting has swept nothing, and its flat alpha would read as evidence for program order when it is evidence of nothing

gates.name: V3 geometry pinned
gates.prediction: BLOCK_M, BLOCK_SIZE_N and BLOCK_SIZE_K are the same at every setting
gates.rule: block sizes measured are exactly {64, 256} at BLOCK_SIZE_N=64, BLOCK_SIZE_K=64
gates.invalidates: P5, hence every contrast: alpha_fitted is (alpha_b + phi) / (1 + phi + delta), and phi is common to both sides of a difference only while BM, BN and K are identical on both sides of it; with them pinned a contrast is the alpha_b difference scaled by 1/(1 + phi + delta), and with them not pinned it is nothing

gates.name: V4 compute reference
gates.prediction: every setting qualified its own BLOCK_M=256 ladder as a compute branch
gates.rule: no refusals and no missing references
gates.invalidates: the membership decision at every setting whose reference is missing or refused, hence that setting's alpha and every contrast it enters. A reference that is proportional but at the wrong level classifies every tread against a branch 40x too steep and prints blanks

gates.name: V5 alpha identifiable
gates.prediction: enough settings measured alpha over enough memory-bound treads
gates.rule: >= 3 settings with >= 3 memory-bound treads and a fitted alpha
gates.invalidates: every claim gate: a contrast between two settings needs both of them

gates.name: V6 replication
gates.prediction: a setting's treads reproduce between repeats
gates.invalidates: every claim gate's noise floor, which is measured from these repeats and not assumed

gates.name: V7 override applied
gates.prediction: every setting recompiled, so num_stages, num_warps and GROUP_SIZE_M reached the kernel
gates.rule: >= 1 fresh Triton artefact per setting and > 0 timings executed
gates.invalidates: everything. All three knobs are compile-time constants of the Triton kernel, so a setting that compiled nothing measured the previous setting again and its 'effect' is zero by construction

gates.name: V8 non-vacuity
gates.prediction: this report examined real treads and formed real contrasts
gates.rule: > 0 treads, > 0 per-repeat fits, and >= 2 of the 3 contrasts formed
gates.invalidates: the entire report. A check that examined nothing also reports zero failures, which is the shape this study has already published once

gates.name: V9 compiled shared memory
gates.prediction: Triton allocated the shared memory the residency model assumed
gates.rule: every setting within 10% of num_stages (BM BK + BK BN) b, and zero register spills
gates.observed: not probed: vLLM exposes no fused_moe_kernel with a Triton cache under either known path, so the compiled shared memory could not be read
gates.invalidates: nothing on its own, but it leaves the residency column a COMPUTED UPPER BOUND rather than a checked one: the register limit is not modelled and can only lower residency, so a report under a not-probed V9 may quote the ladder's ORDER and not its values

gates.name: V10 one instrument
gates.prediction: every cell was timed by the instrument the roof was measured with
gates.invalidates: every alpha in this report and every comparison of one with the study's roof: two timing loops measure two different things and a row with no instrument is a row from before the instrument had a name

gates.name: P1 occupancy
gates.prediction: alpha rises with resident blocks per SM
gates.rule: swing >= 0.058 in alpha between 2 blocks/SM and 6 blocks/SM, and every step rising

gates.name: P2 program order
gates.rule: alpha(G=64) / alpha(G=1) <= 0.235, which is 2x the prediction

gates.name: P3 warp control
gates.prediction: alpha tracks resident BLOCKS, not resident WARPS
gates.rule: |warp swing| < |occupancy swing|, and only where the occupancy swing cleared its own threshold of 0.058
gates.observed: occupancy swing -0.028 did not clear 0.058, so the warp swing +0.065 has nothing to be smaller than: two noise measurements compared would pass half the time

gates.name: P6 depth control
gates.prediction: alpha tracks resident BLOCKS, not pipeline DEPTH
gates.rule: the pure num_stages contrast at fixed residency is smaller than the occupancy contrast
gates.observed: no two num_stages settings computed the same resident-block count, so the pure pipeline-depth effect was not measured and the confound in P1 is UNREMOVED on this card
gates.invalidates: P1's reading as a footprint effect: alpha moving with the ladder is equally consistent with latency hiding, and this run cannot say which
